prompt: Photorealistic studio product rendering of a 20 mm robot fingertip tactile cartridge in operating moment, sectioned close-up isometric side view with slight vertical exploded gaps for visibility but preserving functional touching order bottom to top: dark finger holder block, light-grey rigid mounting core, large lower green readout board with chips, upper thin green taxel electrode board, single dense array of tiny translucent rounded silicone pillars 1-2 mm tall, single thin translucent vibration film directly under skin, full-width matte grey ridged silicone cap with same footprint as boards covering entire top. Real materials, sharp focus, mechanism readable.
